question_text: A high-ranking government official, Director Reyes, is known for hosting lavish parties and wearing expensive designer clothes. Some citizens complain that this contradicts the norm of 'simple living' under RA 6713. Which of the following best describes the application of simple living to public officials?

options.text: Simple living only applies to low-ranking officials, not high-ranking ones.
Simple living requires officials to live in poverty and avoid all luxuries.
Simple living means officials should avoid conspicuous consumption and maintain a modest lifestyle appropriate to their position.
Simple living is a personal choice and not a legal requirement under RA 6713.
